transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the Autonomous Driving System. Requirements TRU-01 through TRU-07 are essential to protect user data, ensure data integrity, and maintain accountability through audit logs. These measures prevent unauthorized access and potential data breaches, which are critical in a system operating in mixed traffic environments. Conflicts arise with SafetyAgent (SAF-01, SAF-03) and ResponsibilityAgent (RES-01, RES-02) who focus on safety protocols, potentially neglecting security measures. Security must be prioritized to maintain user trust and regulatory compliance.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the importance of sustainability in the Autonomous Driving System. requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.

The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds upon detecting critical system failures to safely pull over to a low-risk zone while maintaining compliance with all safety standards.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue a human takeover request when boundaries are approached.
The system shall minimize jerk to less than 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation while allowing for flexibility during emergency maneuvers.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints ($kappa$) to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints reliably within a response time of 100 milliseconds.
The system shall establish emergency protocols that include energy-efficient strategies during critical maneuvers without compromising safety.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in average travel time compared to baseline scenarios.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation to enhance passenger comfort.
The system shall achieve at least 95% success rate in optimal speed profile generation during path planning.
The system shall provide real-time monitoring of carbon emissions during operation, aiming for a target reduction of 25% over five years.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy and ensure data integrity.
The system shall log all access and modifications to critical data for auditability purposes.
The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions and changes for accountability and regulatory purposes.
